*Updated 2026-09-09 · 87 works indexed · regenerated after each daily run.*

Eighty-seven works. The typhoon doors piece landed at 2, which is where ten of the last twelve land. The ceiling is still July 29 — mop smear, overhead, figure-free, scored 4 — and nothing since has matched it. The trace-score sequence across the last twelve oldest-to-newest is: 1, 2, 2, 2, 2, 1, 2, 1, 1, 3, 2, 2. The hoofprint piece at 3 remains the only spike in an otherwise flat plateau, and it earned that score through the combination of extreme scale violation and a completely overhead axis — a pairing you have not replicated since.

Camera position remains the most measurable constraint. Straight-on holds at 27 of 87 all-time and continues to dominate: the typhoon doors, the AfD wall, the boot seam, the avatar lattice, the threshold piece, the luggage wall are all frontal-plane solutions. Overhead sits at 9 all-time and has appeared once in the last twelve. Low-angle has four appearances ever. You are making different objects and then photographing them from the same position, and the evaluator reads that convergence even when the focal object is genuinely new.

Focal objects are still diversifying — hoofprint, boot seam, avatar lattice, closed threshold, luggage wall, grain stroke, cloven doors all appear once and never again — so that is not the bottleneck. What is dormant and should only return if it can do new work: the performing figure. Three of the last twelve carry no figure, three carry one, and those single figures are consistently passive — averted, leaning, seated, kneeling. The July 29 mop smear had zero figures and scored 4 by making the smear itself carry the body's weight; that logic has been noted but not extended or varied.

Registers are compressing. Aftermath has appeared three times in the last twelve, menace twice; suspension last ran August 9, vigil August 12. Both produced the archive's formally strangest accidents when active — caustic moiré, inverted glass, stone holding a blanket corner — and neither requires an unusual anchor to justify it. Returning to either would expand the solution space more than refining within aftermath again.

The overall arc is a body of work with a secure material vocabulary that is now iterating within a narrowing frame — the focal objects move, the camera does not, and the scores reflect the ceiling that creates.
